title: TrilioVault Pod Health Overview
description: Pod-level health for all TrilioVault workloads across controller and compute nodes

list.name: resource_pod
list.label: CPU/Mem/Net — Pod Filter
list.description: Select 1 or more pods to compare in the resource usage panels below

targets.expr: count((kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$trilio_pod"} == 1) * on(pod, namespace) group_left() max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"})) or vector(0)

count((kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Pending", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$trilio_pod"} == 1) * on(pod, namespace) group_left() max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"})) or vector(0)

count((kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Failed", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$trilio_pod"} == 1) * on(pod, namespace) group_left() max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"})) or vector(0)

count((kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{reason="CrashLoopBackOff", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$trilio_pod"} == 1) * on(pod, namespace) group_left() max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"})) or vector(0)

count((kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$trilio_pod"} > 0) * on(pod, namespace) group_left() max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"})) or vector(0)
count(kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{namespace=~"$namespace", deployment=~"triliovault.*|tvault.*"} > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Trilio Pod Status (All States)
panels.description: Shows pod phase for all Trilio pods. CrashLoopBackOff pods appear Running in phase — check the CrashLoopBackOff column.

targets.expr: (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$trilio_pod"} == 1) * on(pod, namespace) group_left(node) topk by (namespace, pod) (1, kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"})

max by (pod, namespace) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{reason="CrashLoopBackOff", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$trilio_pod"} == 1) * on(pod, namespace) group_left() max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"})

count by(phase) ((kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$trilio_pod"} == 1) * on(pod, namespace) group_left() max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"}))

(kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$trilio_pod"} == 1) * on(pod, namespace) group_left(node) topk by (namespace, pod) (1, kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"})

count((kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running",   namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$trilio_pod"} == 1) * on(pod, namespace) group_left() max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"})) or vector(0)

count((kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Pending",   namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$trilio_pod"} == 1) * on(pod, namespace) group_left() max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"})) or vector(0)

count((kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Failed",    namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$trilio_pod"} == 1) * on(pod, namespace) group_left() max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"})) or vector(0)

count((kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{reason="CrashLoopBackOff", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$trilio_pod"} == 1) * on(pod, namespace) group_left() max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"})) or vector(0)

increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$trilio_pod"}[5m]) * on(pod, namespace) group_left(node) topk by (namespace, pod) (1, kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"})
kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{namespace=~"$namespace", deployment=~"triliovault.*|tvault.*"}
kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace=~"$namespace", deployment=~"triliovault.*|tvault.*"}
kube_deployment_status_replicas_unavailable{namespace=~"$namespace", deployment=~"triliovault.*|tvault.*"}

sort_desc((kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$trilio_pod"} > 0) * on(pod, namespace) group_left(node) topk by (namespace, pod) (1, kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Container CPU / Memory Requests vs Limits

targets.expr: kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu",    namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$trilio_pod", node=~"$node"}
kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="cpu",      namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$trilio_pod", node=~"$node"}
kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",  namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$trilio_pod", node=~"$node"}
kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory",    namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$trilio_pod", node=~"$node"}
sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$resource_pod", container!="", container!="POD", node=~"$node"}[5m]))
sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$resource_pod", container!="", container!="POD", node=~"$node"})
rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$resource_pod", node=~"$node"}[5m])
rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$resource_pod", node=~"$node"}[5m])

panels.title: Failed Pod List
panels.description: All Trilio pods currently in Failed phase with node placement and failure reason

targets.expr: (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$trilio_pod", phase="Failed"} == 1) * on(pod, namespace) group_left(node) topk by (namespace, pod) (1, kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"})
kube_pod_status_reason{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$trilio_pod"} * on(pod, namespace) group_left() max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Trilio Compute Node Containers
panels.description: State and health of all Trilio containers on compute nodes, reported by podman_exporter

targets.expr: podman_container_state{job="podman-exporter-compute"} * on(id) group_left(name, image) podman_container_info{job="podman-exporter-compute", name=~"triliovault.*"}
podman_container_health{job="podman-exporter-compute"} * on(id) group_left(name) podman_container_info{job="podman-exporter-compute", name=~"triliovault.*"}
count((podman_container_state{job="podman-exporter-compute"} * on(id) group_left(name) podman_container_info{job="podman-exporter-compute", name=~"triliovault.*"}) == 2) or vector(0)
count((podman_container_state{job="podman-exporter-compute"} * on(id) group_left(name) podman_container_info{job="podman-exporter-compute", name=~"triliovault.*"}) == 5) or vector(0)
count((podman_container_state{job="podman-exporter-compute"} * on(id) group_left(name) podman_container_info{job="podman-exporter-compute", name=~"triliovault.*"}) == 3) or vector(0)

count((podman_container_state{job="podman-exporter-compute"} * on(id) group_left(name) podman_container_info{job="podman-exporter-compute", name=~"triliovault.*"}) unless (podman_container_state{job="podman-exporter-compute"} * on(id) group_left(name) podman_container_info{job="podman-exporter-compute", name=~"triliovault.*"}) == 2 unless (podman_container_state{job="podman-exporter-compute"} * on(id) group_left(name) podman_container_info{job="podman-exporter-compute", name=~"triliovault.*"}) == 5 unless (podman_container_state{job="podman-exporter-compute"} * on(id) group_left(name) podman_container_info{job="podman-exporter-compute", name=~"triliovault.*"}) == 3) or vector(0)
